primary_measure: Signed EEF endpoint contrast (tomato-reference minus soup-reference) projected onto the initial soup-to-tomato direction in the tabletop XY plane. Report separately for each observed/future appearance combination; average seeds within state.
appearance_measure: Tinted-future minus original-future EEF endpoint/path change at fixed reference motion and observed appearance. Also report its interaction with observed appearance. No calibrated equivalence margin or invariance claim.
interpretation: Scripted first approach is a motion/region composite, not isolated object identity. Table tint is a broad appearance perturbation. Original-observation/tinted-future is a mismatch stress test; the full observation/future factorial distinguishes consistency effects descriptively. Three development states and two recipient seeds only. No full-task success estimate.
stopping_rule: 36 native/identity/round-trip control branches first (3 states x 2 seeds x 2 observed appearances x 3 arms). All reconstruction gates must pass and all reference reconstructions must receive actual AI-assisted visual review before the 48 factorial donor branches. No silent resume, threshold change or candidate selection based on policy effects. Human review deferred as authorized.
